name: Louis
source:
A knight from Campanule. He was born as an illegitimate prince and lives as he pleases; he is a man with a calm atmosphere. At first glance, he is the embodiment of a charming "ideal prince" but inside and away from the surface there is a part of him drowning in deep weariness.

His mansion has an enormous garden at the front of it. The living room is lined with delicate details.

[from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/03/reines-des-fleurs-introduction/]otome-jikan[/url]]
